title: Dashboard text global filter cannot default to the current ISO week (2026-W47-style period keys)
body:
## What (18.5.0)

An app's dashboards slice weekly data by a text period key (`cost_week` / `supply_week`, e.g. `2026-W46`), because its weekly master data is keyed by ISO week rather than by a date. The dashboard's global text filter works (typing `2026-W46` + Enter narrows to that week). However:

- it **cannot default** to the current ISO week, so on open the dashboard sums every week, and a "this week's sellable tonnage" view shows a multi-week total;
- date filters do have relative presets (本周, 上周), but they do not apply to a text period key.

## Ask

A dynamic default for a dashboard filter on a text field. This could be a macro such as `{{currentIsoWeek}}` / `{{isoWeek(today())}}`, or a CEL default evaluated at view time. Alternatively, allow a "relative ISO week" preset on a filter declared over a week-key field.

## Consumer

The app's 「工厂原料占用」 and 「牌号 × 工厂可售量」 dashboards. The app has changed their wording to explain the filter and does not work around this.
